from harvests import load_harvests, ROWS
from summary import HarvestSummary

MEAN = sum(v for _, v in ROWS) / len(ROWS)


def test_mean_of_stored():
    assert abs(HarvestSummary(load_harvests()).mean_kilos() - MEAN) < 1e-9


def test_count_of_list():
    assert HarvestSummary(list(load_harvests())).count() == len(ROWS)
